rows.label: tlk42300023_03_msg0001
rows.name:
No matter how much Avaritia develops,
the Twelve Nopon Siblings never get
any new products, mo!

rows.label: tlk42300023_03_msg0002
rows.name:
Motata-san said it'd be after the
eleven siblings returned from their
journey for materials, mo.

rows.label: tlk42300023_03_msg0003
rows.name:
Invidia and Superbia... and I
heard they went to lands I've
never even heard of, mo.

rows.label: tlk42300023_03_msg0004
rows.name:
I was also told that unless someone
goes to get them, they'll surely
never come back, mo.
